settings.injection_state: actual cloud-top height; independent of vertical layer count

domain_adequacy.interpretation: Finite mass-domain adequacy only; separate grid and timestep convergence required.

runs.evidence: Deterministic fixed-pivot solution of the inherited mean collision, chipping, deposition and settling laws; no integer/fractional packet mixing or batched sticking. Finite mass domain, mass-grid diffusion, time and spatial errors require separate controls. Whole-aggregate fracture, evolving morphology and realistic moist trajectories remain absent.
runs.reading_rule: Quantiles are discrete pivot quantiles and inherit mass-grid resolution. Mass-domain exits are excluded from snowfall and explicitly accounted for. Optical extinction uses Qext=2 and the exact discretized projected-area moment; the 5% distance is homogeneous direct-beam attenuation, not visual range.
